description:
Reid eTrike | 500W Electric Tricycle
Make everyday journeys easier with the Reid eTrike, a practical 500W electric tricycle designed for comfortable riding and carrying more. Combining a stable three-wheel design, generous cargo capacity and powerful electric assistance, it's a versatile choice for shopping, commuting, deliveries and everyday transport.
Powered by a 48V 500W motor, the eTrike provides electric assistance to help tackle hills and longer journeys. Its 48V 14Ah (672Wh) battery offers an estimated range of up to 60 miles (97km), depending on terrain, rider weight and riding conditions. The Ananda colour display features Bluetooth connectivity and app compatibility, while the throttle offers an additional way to control electric assistance.
Designed for comfort and convenience, the eTrike features an alloy folding step-through frame, making getting on and off easier and offering a more practical storage solution. A comfortable saddle with integrated backrest, ergonomic handlebars and upright riding position help support a relaxed ride.
With generous cargo-carrying capacity, the eTrike is well suited to shopping, deliveries and transporting everyday essentials. The rear basket can carry up to 50kg, while the front basket offers an additional 12kg capacity. Combined with a maximum total payload of 210kg, there's plenty of room for carrying more on everyday journeys.
A Shimano 6-speed drivetrain provides flexibility across different routes, while Star Union hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors deliver controlled stopping power. Wide 20 x 3.0" urban tyres provide stability and grip, with integrated front and rear lights adding practicality for everyday use.
Combining electric assistance, comfortable features and substantial cargo capacity, the Reid eTrike offers a convenient alternative to a conventional bicycle for riders looking to carry more and travel with less effort.
The Reid eTrike is ideal for:

Shopping and everyday errands, with front and rear baskets for carrying essentials

Business deliveries, with a rear basket rated to 50kg

Carrying heavier loads, with a maximum total payload of 210kg

Longer journeys, with a 48V 14Ah (672Wh) battery offering an estimated range of up to 60 miles (97km)

Powerful electric assistance, with a 48V 500W motor and throttle control

Comfortable everyday riding, with an integrated backrest and ergonomic handlebars

Convenient storage, with a folding step-through alloy frame

Flexible gearing, with a Shimano 6-speed drivetrain

Controlled stopping power, with Star Union hydraulic disc brakes and 180mm rotors

Connected ride information, with an Ananda colour display featuring Bluetooth and app compatibility

Range figures are estimates and will vary depending on terrain, rider weight and riding conditions. Front basket maximum load capacity: 12kg. Rear basket maximum load capacity: 50kg. Maximum total payload: 210kg.

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
